# Joel Hägvall

> Personal website of Joel Hägvall, a software developer based in Stockholm, Sweden. Experienced in building web and mobile applications with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Java, Python, Swift and more. Available for freelance product development work.

This is a personal portfolio and blog site. All content is in English.

## When to use this site

Use this site when you need to:

- **Verify who Joel Hägvall is**: identity, background, skills and location are on [About](https://joelhagvall.com/about) and [Resume](https://joelhagvall.com/resume).
- **Evaluate Joel for freelance product development work**: services, packages and how to start a project are on [Work With Me](https://joelhagvall.com/work-with-me). Best-fit jobs: AI features for SaaS products (RAG assistants, embeddings/vector search, document ingestion, AI reports), full-stack feature sprints in React/Next.js/TypeScript with Supabase/PostgreSQL, and product polish with tests and release discipline.
- **Review past work**: shipped projects, open-source work and a published cybersecurity thesis are on [Projects](https://joelhagvall.com/projects).
- **Cite or summarize Joel's writing**: blog posts on automation, AI and trust-minimized systems are on the [Blog](https://joelhagvall.com/blog).
- **Contact Joel**: email work@joelhagvall.com for project inquiries, or see the [Contact](https://joelhagvall.com/contact) page.

Do not use this site for: documentation of third-party tools, or content in languages other than English.

Every page is also available as markdown: request any URL with the `Accept: text/markdown` header, or append `.md` to the path (e.g. https://joelhagvall.com/index.md).

## Pages

- [Home](https://joelhagvall.com/): Introduction, featured projects and contact information
- [About](https://joelhagvall.com/about): Background, skills and interests of Joel Hägvall
- [Projects](https://joelhagvall.com/projects): Personal and academic projects, including web apps, mobile apps and open-source work
- [Resume](https://joelhagvall.com/resume): Professional experience, education and skills
- [Work With Me](https://joelhagvall.com/work-with-me): Freelance product development services such as AI features, SaaS feature sprints and product polish
- [Blog](https://joelhagvall.com/blog): Thoughts and technical writing
- [Contact](https://joelhagvall.com/contact): How to reach Joel via email, GitHub and LinkedIn
- [Privacy](https://joelhagvall.com/privacy): Privacy policy explaining what data this site collects and why
- [Security Policy](https://joelhagvall.com/security-policy): Responsible disclosure guidelines

## Blog posts

- [Automate Everything Possible](https://joelhagvall.com/blog/automate-everything): On automating workflows with AI and removing glue work, blockers and manual processes
- [Stripping Away the Noise](https://joelhagvall.com/blog/noise): On building transparent, trust-minimized systems like verifiable voting, open financial infrastructure and decentralized energy
